deploybot: PROMOTE_BLOCKED: artifact upload checksum mismatch for package service-api
deploybot: canary tag: canary-20260321-42
deploybot: failing step: manifest-verify
deploybot: /var/log/deploybot/upload: ERROR: shard 4 checksum 0x7a9f != expected 0x2b3e

maria-ops: seeing this on canary. UI smoke fails during extract on runner-5
owen-ci: logs show 3/4 shards present in registry. multipart manifest lists 4 parts
samir: probable multipart upload reassembly bug, seen before during large wheels
katie-eng: quick fix: manual promote to last-good digest? anyone object to pinning to digest sha256:abc1234
maria-ops: we have a release cut in ~50m. pinning would unblock customer demos
anjali: can we try `deploybot reupload --shard 4 --retry 3` from the staging-uploader host? I can run
owen-ci: +1 try reupload, but if it fails we should pin and create a rebuild ticket
deploybot: RETRY_STARTED by anjali on staging-uploader-2
deploybot: REUPLOAD_FAIL: 504 GatewayTimeout during multipart finalize (attempt 2)
maria-ops: reupload failing, looks like S3 region flapping
samir: confirmed AWS 504s in cloudtrail for PutObjectPart during that interval
release-manager: decision needed: pin prior digest or delay release window
katie-eng: I'm in favor of pin (manual promote) for this release window; we'll schedule immediate rebuild/test
anjali: I'll open ticket infra#1234 to rebuild artifact and re-run smoke. ETA ~2 hours
maria-ops: manual promote plan: `deploybot promote --from-digest sha256:abc1234 --to canary-20260321-42 --force`
owen-ci: also add rollback playbook note: if smoke fails after promote, revert using `deploybot promote --from-digest sha256:<old> --to canary-20260321-42`
release-manager: okay pin approved. I'll call change window at 18:00 UTC; release notes: include note about artifact rebuild scheduled
maria-ops: adding short blurb for ops release notes and emailing CS about demo unblock :email:
katie-eng: :thumbsup: will monitor canary for 15m then promote to stable
anjali: infra#1234 created: https://redwood/infra/1234
deploybot: PROMOTE_DONE by release-manager
maria-ops: monitoring... smoke all green on canary-1 for now :eyes:
owen-ci: leaving a postmortem checklist item about multipart upload verifier in CI
samir: adding regression test for multipart finalize to nightly pipeline
release-manager: thanks team — closing thread, follow-ups in infra#1234 and release notes
